adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is now an array and for COLLECTIVE team events the code explicitly appends additional members’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking it only connects a single destination calendar record: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (lines ~1843-1871 in the diff). All other destinations in the array are not persisted on the booking. Later flows shown in the diff (confirm/payment/reminder/editLocation/requestReschedule/deleteCredential) rebuild `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) and wrap it into an array, meaning the additional host calendars cannot be reconstructed and are effectively lost for subsequent operations.
